parameters.description: Look up a Kesar & Co. order. Pass the order ID from the email (format KC-1234), or an empty string to look up by the sender's email address. Returns status, items, amounts, courier, tracking link and dates, but only if the order belongs to the person who sent the email. Call this before stating anything about an order.

Search the official Kesar & Co. FAQ and policy document: shipping times and fees, cash on delivery, cancellation, returns, damaged/wrong/missing items, refunds, product facts, product safety, contact details. Pass a short English keyword query. This is the only permitted source for policy and product answers.

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
One email per webhook call. **Config** holds the prompt version (v1/v2), the confidence threshold and the Google Sheet ID. Orders, FAQ and brand voice are fetched fresh.

## 2. Classify + validate
LLM returns JSON. Code validates it against the schema, repairs formatting slips, asks the LLM once more if still invalid, then falls back to `other` + needs human.

## 3. Hard rules in code
Order lookup, privacy check, date maths, return eligibility, needs-human reasons. The LLM never decides these.

## 4. AI agent drafts the reply
Tools: `get_order` (only returns the sender's own order) and `search_faq`. "other" skips the agent.

## 5. Guardrails, tickets, audit log
Draft is checked against the data. Returns and complaints upsert a ticket (one open ticket per order). Every email gets an audit row.
